title: A connected world around 117 CE
summary: Three source-linked geographic readings: Rome at 117 CE, Han at 123 CE, and Aksum at 130 CE. Territorial annotations reference reviewed source polygons; no invented campaign or trade paths are supplied.
attribution: Civil Atlas contributors. Borders: Cliopatria, Seshat Global History Databank (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 12, 247, 2025), CC BY 4.0.

steps.title: Rome and the Mediterranean
steps.narrative: Explore the Roman Empire (Cliopatria) interpretation reported by Cliopatria for 117 to 126. This view selects 117; the source's interval does not establish an exact, unchanged frontier throughout that period. Compare the outline with geographic context and inspect its source citation.
